message: the `globalAria` table read from axe-core holds no `aria-labelledby`
$reason: The global ARIA attributes read from axe-core have lost `aria-labelledby` — the one `wrapper-with-aria-and-no-role`, the select's measured case (`lesson-65`), stands on. A package bump can move the list with no line here moving, and point 9 would look through every wrapper carrying it. The anchor makes that loss a verdict rather than a silence.
